events.evidence: The People's Bank of China devalues the Chinese yuan by two percent in an attempt to boost its economy, a move which could spark a currency war
Debris from a Buk surface-to-air missile is found at an unspecified location in eastern Ukraine

label.note: Yuan devaluation and currency-war talk dominate; Ukraine missile debris and Nigeria attack add risk.
